title: Dijon Mustard Vinaigrette with Lemon and Fines Herbes
summary: A classic mustard and lemon dressing lifted with fresh chopped herbs, smooth, glossy and ready to toss through any green salad.
equipment: small bowl and whisk or jar with a tight lid

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Grate
steps.text: Finely grate the shallot into a small bowl or jar.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Add 4 tsp Dijon mustard, 2 tbsp lemon juice, ½ tsp salt and ¼ tsp pepper and whisk to combine.

steps.title: Emulsify
steps.text: Slowly whisk in 120 ml olive oil, or seal the jar and shake hard, until thick, creamy and emulsified.

steps.title: Herbs
steps.text: Stir in the parsley, chervil, tarragon and chives.

steps.title: Taste
steps.text: Taste and adjust the balance of mustard, lemon and salt.

tips: Whisking the oil in slowly, a little at a time, helps the dressing emulsify properly instead of separating.
A jar with a tight lid is an easy alternative to whisking; just shake hard until everything comes together.
Add the herbs just before serving for the freshest flavour and colour.
storage: Keeps covered in the fridge for up to a week; bring back to room temperature and shake well before using. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
